purpose: Third regional combat audit covering Karamja TzekHaar support equipment, Corporeal Beast supply, and the Blessed flask multi-region production chain.

policy.hard_gate_rule: Only use required_regions when every listed elective region is truly mandatory. Long production chains with alternate supply sources use region_hints and explicit region pressure instead.
policy.external_area_rule: The Arc/Wushanko remains an unresolved external destination in the current Equilibrium region model and must not be silently assigned to an elective region.
policy.boss_strategy_rule: Record persistent support items and acquisition dependencies without turning this dataset into a boss strategy guide.

activity_additions.name: Fight Cauldron obsidian armour progression
activity_additions.category: TzekHaar combat support and cape progression
requirements: The Brink of Extinction in the normal game
Fight Cauldron access for obsidian shards
unlocks: Obsidian armour crafted from Fight Cauldron obsidian shards
Up to 55% damage reduction from obsidian monsters in Fight Kiln and TzKal-Zuk encounters
Obsidian helms with increased accuracy against TzekHaar wave monsters
Fight Cauldron TokKul donation for an additional 10 percentage points of obsidian-armour damage reduction while active
activity_additions.notes: The protection applies through the TzKal-Zuk encounter, including Zuk. The obsidian helm accuracy effect applies to the surrounding TzekHaar but not Zuk himself. This gives Karamja continuing value after the TokHaar-Kal prerequisite is obtained.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Quest auto-completion can satisfy the normal quest gate, but Karamja remains the Fight Cauldron and obsidian-shard source unless Equilibrium explicitly supplies the equipment.

equipment_additions.name: TokKul-Zo
equipment_additions.category: TzHaar and TzekHaar combat support ring
requirements: The Elder Kiln in the normal game
effects: 10% increased damage against TzHaar, TokHaar, TzekHaar and Igneous TzekHaar
The damage effect works on TzekHaar waves but not TzKal-Zuk himself
Teleports around TzHaar City including Fight Cave, Fight Kiln and Fight Cauldron
equipment_additions.notes: This is a Karamja support unlock for the wave portions of the Zuk encounter and for the earlier TzHaar progression. Do not describe it as a 10% damage bonus against Zuk himself.

equipment_additions.name: Corporeal Beast holy-elixir supply
equipment_additions.category: combat-support and Blessed flask ingredient supply
requirements: Summer's End for the normal-game Corporeal Beast progression
unlocks: Necrite and phasmatite stone-spirit supply relevant to Blessed flask crafting
equipment_additions.notes: The Corporeal Beast cavern entrance is in the Wilderness. The lair itself is not dangerous Wilderness territory, but Forinthry is the useful region dependency for entering the normal self-supply chain. Holy elixir can also come from the tormented wraith, so this row describes the primary practical regional source rather than claiming Corp is the only source.

equipment_additions.name: Blessed flask production chain
requirements: Blessed flask shell and glorious silvthril chain
region_pressure: Desert: the normal direct source for the 1,200 red sandstone used in the shell chain; alternate account sources can weaken this as a hard region gate.
Tirannwn: crystal-flecked sandstone and 5,000 harmonic dust are naturally supplied through Prifddinas; some alternate sources mean this is recorded as pressure rather than an unconditional hard gate.
Karamja: Holy water production is learned through Legends' Quest and uses the Kharazi Jungle water pool.
Forinthry: Corporeal Beast is the practical normal self-supply source for the holy elixir and several required stone spirits; the tormented wraith is an alternate holy-elixir source.
External unresolved: 250 alaea sea salt comes from the Arc/Wushanko chain, which is not currently assigned to an Equilibrium elective region.
effects: Holds up to 80 doses of extreme prayer in one inventory slot
At level 99 Prayer, 80 doses can represent up to 45,200 Prayer points before other modifiers
Holy wrench increases the Prayer restored per extreme-prayer dose and works with the Blessed flask
equipment_additions.notes: This is a real region-planning chain because no trading makes the ingredient sources matter, but it would be wrong to display Desert + Tirannwn + Karamja + Forinthry as four unconditional required picks while alternate supply routes and the unresolved Arc exist. Keep the full pressure visible instead.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Re-evaluate individual ingredient gates when Equilibrium publishes external-area handling, quest auto-completion details, or League-specific supply passives.
